answer.answer: Nylon is the only polymer group with a positive median zeta potential, at about +21.8 mV. However, 20 of the 25 nylon measurements come from one paper (PMC9370135), and the sign flips from positive in DI water to negative in culture medium, so the result is not robust across sources or media.
